rejected_hypotheses.hypothesis: A new entrant can take old exact-unit LP rewards or use incumbent residual/compound to satisfy its execution floor.
rejected_hypotheses.source_basis: Vault._join and ContributionPricing.begin/contributionNAV/finish checkpoint and exclude incumbent budgets, harvest own-swap receipts before shares/membership, and require actual marginal deployed LP. No new counterexample established.

rejected_hypotheses.hypothesis: Changing royalty GCD from3 or2 to1 awards new NFTs an older normalized ticket book.
rejected_hypotheses.source_basis: ticketStart is cumulative raw weight; old book prefix equals old eligibleWeight/unit. Later starts normalize strictly after the old prefix. Mixed cohorts useunit1. No new counterexample established.

rejected_hypotheses.hypothesis: A no-swap hybrid replacement can silently create an inactive main or a third residual.
rejected_hypotheses.source_basis: Manager/Executor require stored tick in main before/after ordinary replacement, prove exact Vault-owned physical L and track one associated residual; hybrid post-allocation floor is checked. No unsafe fallback is added.

rejected_hypotheses.hypothesis: Any caller can start terminal exit or redirect principal because several canonical completion actions are permissionless.
rejected_hypotheses.source_basis: Migration begin/close/allocation/distribution remain governance-only; canonical permissionless settle/export/fund complete only an already authenticated immutable handoff and exact backing pairing. NFT-owner fallback pays current owner only.

rejected_hypotheses.hypothesis: Reference/execution overlap necessarily self-invalidates guarded swaps.
rejected_hypotheses.source_basis: Explicit execution1 captures source vector and proves actual-core quote output and complete market post-state before settlement, retaining live proof and exact context; same-core principal destination as reference remains deliberately excluded.

accepted_or_external_boundaries.detail: Spot placement/valuation was selected by the user. Two addresses/independence IDs do not establish economic independence or usable depth. Own-principal reference is excluded; qualified external two-source markets remain absent.

Service waits at threshold/outside/pending geometry; on-chain compoundReady retains its own interval/raw rebalance rules. Direct authorized keeper can use the wider on-chain path. A mandatory rule would be an economic/liveness policy change.

600-second sampled evidence/max gap300 and service240 cadence plus jitter are not continuous price history or MEV immunity. Source failure/reference disagreement deliberately blocks ordinary swapping.
Emergency mask0 can bypass financial/timing guards and lose nearly all principal. Auth, exact custody/accounting, fixed pair, lifecycle and typed operation constraints remain mandatory.

Original-currency recovery uses reviewed registration/capacity up to64ERC20+ETH and exact conventional transfers. Unreadable currency isolation preserves old cohort; zero initial cohort requires explicit governance allocation. Malicious/frozen/unsupported tokens cannot be universally paid.

Mint-order finalized draws deliberately block provider rotation and canonical handoff if an original request cannot finalize; no reroll. Live VRF/SeaDrop manifest/payment/onboarding/runtime acceptance remains required.

Every principal raw unit is cumulative-floor allocated by bucket shares; rejecting holders are deferred/backed, governance pays batch gas, owner fallback is available. Frozen fixed ZZZ still prevents movement of that token.
No executable patch was justified during this review. Oracle3/Vault32-byte runtime margins and current20M/24M review profiles remain exact earlier evidence; no normal gate/default was raised.

primary_references.application: Batched position action and delta-resolution structure corroborated; installed PositionManager/DeltaResolver code is the exact dependency authority, rather than copying documentation examples into PoPL.

Request-ID association, callback storage separated from follow-on reveal, no cancellation/reroll, sufficient subscription funds and target confirmation settings. Current custom ABI/coordinator checks still need actual provider qualification; do not infer Robinhood support from interface compatibility.
RoyaltyInfo requests percentage and receiver; standard does not force marketplace payment. Royalty currency follows sale currency, supporting separate original-currency funded accounting.
